title: The room classifier (TypeScript port)
why: Rule-based classification of a room from geometry, intended use, occupancy and equipment. Deterministic — not a trained model.

title: The commissioning applicability algorithm
why: Judges all 94 test definitions for a room: applicable with the rules that selected it, or not applicable with a justification; never a pass.

title: The design checks
why: Design deficiencies with stable correlation keys: required equipment, connectivity (graph search), placement, PoE budget, sightlines.

title: Result labels and acceptance counts
why: PASS_UNVERIFIED until a different person verifies; no bare PASS anywhere.

title: Recording and verification rules
why: Who may record a result, with which evidence, and the independence rule for verification.

title: Lifecycle gates
why: The governed one-step lifecycle and its blocking conditions.

title: The parity test
why: Proves the port reproduces the demonstrator on 92 golden cases.

title: The design tokens
why: Aurora colours, type, spacing and evidence-state colours: the source of every CSS variable.
content:
{
  "$description": "Empathia design tokens. Dark values are the demonstrator's AURORA skin (src/v30-aurora.css, V1.3.3+), unchanged. Light values ('Aurora Daylight') are new in the founder program and keep the same hues at AA contrast on a pale ground. scripts/build-tokens.mjs turns this file into tokens.css; edit this file, never the generated CSS.",
  "$source": "Empathia_V25/work/source-254/src/v30-aurora.css and src/app.css",
  "color": {
    "bg":        { "dark": "#070d1a", "light": "#f3f6fb", "role": "page ground" },
    "bg2":       { "dark": "#0a1222", "light": "#e9eef7", "role": "recessed ground (rails, wells)" },
    "panel":     { "dark": "#0f1a30", "light": "#ffffff", "role": "card / panel surface" },
    "panel2":    { "dark": "#16233e", "light": "#eef2f9", "role": "raised or hovered surface" },
    "line":      { "dark": "rgba(214, 228, 255, 0.09)", "light": "rgba(16, 32, 64, 0.10)", "role": "hairline borders" },
    "line2":     { "dark": "rgba(214, 228, 255, 0.17)", "light": "rgba(16, 32, 64, 0.20)", "role": "strong borders, focus rings base" },
    "tx":        { "dark": "#edf3ff", "light": "#0b1730", "role": "primary text" },
    "tx2":       { "dark": "#aebbd8", "light": "#3a4a68", "role": "secondary text" },
    "tx3":       { "dark": "#7f8fae", "light": "#5c6b88", "role": "muted text (≥ 4.5:1 on panel in both themes)" },
    "accent":    { "dark": "#3fd8ff", "light": "#0b76a8", "role": "interaction and selection (electric cyan; darkened for light ground)" },
    "accent-bg": { "dark": "rgba(63, 216, 255, 0.11)", "light": "rgba(11, 118, 168, 0.10)", "role": "selected row / chip fill" },
    "indigo":    { "dark": "#6473ff", "light": "#4553d6", "role": "depth, secondary series" },
    "violet":    { "dark": "#a68cff", "light": "#6b4fd8", "role": "Learn / SIGNAL mood" },
    "ok":        { "dark": "#3ddc97", "light": "#137a4f", "role": "status: verified / good (always with a word or shape)" },
    "warn":      { "dark": "#f5b942", "light": "#8a5a00", "role": "status: attention / unverified" },
    "bad":       { "dark": "#ff6b6b", "light": "#b42318", "role": "status: failed / blocked" },
    "info":      { "dark": "#7aa7ff", "light": "#2f5bb7", "role": "status: informational / pending" }
  },
  "evidence": {
    "$description": "The eight evidence states of the founder program (directive section 2.3). One hue ramp per state family; every chip also carries its word.",
    "SPECIFIED":              { "dark": "#7f8fae", "light": "#5c6b88" },
    "IMPLEMENTED":            { "dark": "#7aa7ff", "light": "#2f5bb7" },
    "DEMONSTRATED":           { "dark": "#3fd8ff", "light": "#0b76a8" },
    "BUILDER_TESTED":         { "dark": "#6473ff", "light": "#4553d6" },
    "INDEPENDENTLY_AUDITED":  { "dark": "#a68cff", "light": "#6b4fd8" },
    "HARDWARE_VERIFIED":      { "dark": "#3ddc97", "light": "#137a4f" },
    "PRODUCTION_VALIDATED":   { "dark": "#3ddc97", "light": "#137a4f" },
    "CUSTOMER_VALIDATED":     { "dark": "#3ddc97", "light": "#137a4f" }
  },
  "font": {
    "sans":  "ui-sans-serif, system-ui, \"Segoe UI\", Roboto, \"Helvetica Neue\", Arial, sans-serif",
    "serif": "ui-serif, \"New York\", \"Iowan Old Style\", \"Palatino Linotype\", Palatino, Georgia, serif",
    "mono":  "ui-monospace, \"SF Mono\", \"Cascadia Mono\", Menlo, Consolas, monospace"
  },
  "type": {
    "$description": "A 1.2 modular scale from 15 px body (the demonstrator's body size).",
    "xs": "12.5px", "sm": "13.5px", "base": "15px", "md": "18px", "lg": "21.6px", "xl": "26px", "xxl": "31px", "display": "37px"
  },
  "space": { "1": "4px", "2": "8px", "3": "12px", "4": "16px", "5": "24px", "6": "32px", "7": "48px", "8": "64px" },
  "radius": { "sm": "8px", "md": "14px", "pill": "999px" },
  "breakpoint": { "phone": "480px", "tablet": "820px", "desktop": "1180px", "wide": "1520px" },
  "motion": { "ease": "cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1)", "fast": "160ms", "med": "240ms" },
  "shadow": {
    "dark": "0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3), 0 14px 40px rgba(2, 6, 18, 0.5)",
    "light": "0 1px 2px rgba(16, 32, 64, 0.08), 0 10px 30px rgba(16, 32, 64, 0.10)"
  }
}
